title: Add transaction with decimal amount (dot)
steps: Main menu -> 2) Add transaction; Amount: 10.10; Category: Test; Type (WYDATEK/PRZYCHOD): WYDATEK
expected: Transaction added successfully; amount displayed as 10.10 (2 decimal places)

title: Rounding HALF_UP (10.129 -> 10.13)
steps: Main menu -> 2) Add transaction; Amount: 10.129; Category: Test; Type: WYDATEK
expected: Transaction added; amount rounded and displayed as 10.13

title: No floating point errors (0.10 + 0.20 = 0.30)
steps: Main menu -> 2) Add transaction; Amount: 0.10; Category: Test; Type: WYDATEK; Repeat: Amount: 0.20; Category: Test; Type: WYDATEK; Main menu -> 8) Reports -> 2) Period summary; Enter today's date range

title: Filter by amount range
preconditions: App running; at least some data exists
steps: Main menu -> 7) Query / Filter transactions; Provide Min amount: 10.00; Max amount: 20.00; Leave other filters empty; Run query

title: Invalid amount range validation
steps: Main menu -> 7) Query / Filter transactions; Provide Min amount: 20.00; Max amount: 10.00
expected: Validation message shown; user can retry; app does not crash

title: Monthly summary formatting
preconditions: App running; at least one transaction in the selected month
steps: Main menu -> 8) Reports -> 1) Monthly summary; Enter valid month (yyyy-MM)
expected: Income/Expense/Balance displayed; all monetary values formatted to 2 decimals

title: Period summary formatting
steps: Main menu -> 8) Reports -> 2) Period summary; Enter valid date range (yyyy-MM-dd)
expected: Totals displayed; all monetary values formatted to 2 decimals

title: Category breakdown formatting
steps: Main menu -> 8) Reports -> 3) Category breakdown; Enter valid date range (yyyy-MM-dd)
expected: Totals per category displayed; all monetary values formatted to 2 decimals

title: Save with default filename
preconditions: App running; at least one transaction exists
steps: Main menu -> 5) Save transactions to CSV; At prompt press Enter (empty input)
expected: File transactions.csv created in working directory

title: Save with custom filename (without extension)
preconditions: App running; at least one transaction exists
steps: Main menu -> 5) Save transactions to CSV; Input: backup

title: Save to subdirectory path (auto-create directory)
preconditions: App running; at least one transaction exists
steps: Main menu -> 5) Save transactions to CSV; Input: report/transaction1
expected: Directory report/ created if missing; file report/transaction1.csv created

title: Load from custom path
preconditions: App running; file exists (created via save)
steps: Main menu -> 6) Load transactions from CSV; Input: report/transaction1.csv

title: Load missing file handled gracefully
steps: Main menu -> 6) Load transactions from CSV; Input: does-not-exist.csv
expected: Clear error message shown; application continues running
